description: Draft MCP tool list for Provisioning. Each of the fourteen tools maps one-to-one to an operationId in src/contracts/openapi.yaml, calls the same use case as the REST operation, and reports a failure as a tool result marked as an error whose structured content is the REST error body: the same RFC 9457 Problem Details object (schema Problem in src/contracts/openapi.yaml, decisions 0018 and 0023 G5), without instance: type, title, status, an UPPER_SNAKE code, requestId, traceId when the call was traced, errors (the bad inputs of a VALIDATION_FAILED, each named as its tool argument, an unknown argument as arguments, never their values; empty otherwise) and commandId with COMMAND_IN_PROGRESS. Its status is the REST status of the same error. A successful result has no envelope (decision 0023 G7): its structured content is the object REST returns in data (the data schema of the operation's success response in src/contracts/openapi.yaml), and for list_releases, list_commands and admin_list_commands, whose REST data is a list, it is {items: <the REST data list>, page: <the REST meta.page, {limit, nextCursor}>}. Argument and field names are camelCase (projectId, releaseId, commandId, idempotencyKey, limit, cursor; decision 0023 G3); the values of enums and failure codes are unchanged. A mutation tool takes its path identifiers and idempotencyKey only: the server assigns the command number. No tool creates a release; build_release (decision 0014) only starts or retries the build of an existing release; list_releases and list_commands (decision 0014 section 21 ruling 7) are reads. The four admin tools (decision 0023 G9, G10) suspend_website, resume_website, redeploy_release and admin_list_commands need the ADMIN role and take a project ID (and a key for the three mutations); rollback_release (FR-50) keeps its project and release arguments and is ADMIN only in the same way; every other suspend or resume of hosting comes from Payment's and Project's events. Authentication and scopes are open decision OD-05.

tools.name: deploy_release
tools.description: Accept a private candidate deployment of a built release. Public traffic does not move. Refused while another command of the project is in flight, the route is not stable, hosting is offline, or the release is older than the live release. Returns the accepted command (schema CommandAccepted): commandId, status and statusUrl.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key scoped to the project: 1 to 255 bytes of UTF-8, with no control characters and no leading or trailing white space. The same key with the same request returns the original command; with a different request it is refused with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

tools.name: promote_release
tools.description: Accept promotion of a candidate_ready release to public traffic. If the promotion fails, the same command restores the route to the project's live release. Refused while another command of the project is in flight, the route is not stable, hosting is offline, or the release is older than the live release. Returns the accepted command (schema CommandAccepted): commandId, status and statusUrl.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key scoped to the project: 1 to 255 bytes of UTF-8, with no control characters and no leading or trailing white space. The same key with the same request returns the original command; with a different request it is refused with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

tools.name: rollback_release
tools.description: Operator recovery: accept restoring an uncertain route to the project's live release (liveReleaseId), or to the offline page when hostingStatus is offline or the project has no live release. Accepted only when the project's routingStatus is uncertain; releaseId names the release that is still promoting. It cannot be used to leave a healthy live release. Entitlement is not consulted. Only a caller whose roles hold ADMIN (exactly, case-sensitive) may call it, on any project, without the project access check (FR-50, decision 0019 section 7, OD-45); anyone else, the project's owner included, is refused with ACCESS_DENIED before the project is looked at. The command records the admin's subject. The production profile refuses it with OPERATION_UNAVAILABLE. Returns the accepted command (schema CommandAccepted): commandId, status and statusUrl. The reads keep the owner check, so for an ADMIN who does not own the project get_command and get_deployment answer not found; such an admin follows the command through the operator tools or the logs until admin reads are designed (OD-45).

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key scoped to the project: 1 to 255 bytes of UTF-8, with no control characters and no leading or trailing white space. The same key with the same request returns the original command; with a different request it is refused with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

tools.name: get_release
tools.description: Read a release with its source commit, status and step status. Returns schema Release.

tools.name: get_command
tools.description: Read the progress of an accepted command of the project, including a hosting command created from a Payment event. Returns schema Command.

tools.name: get_deployment
tools.description: Read the project's confirmed live release (liveReleaseId), lastCommandNumber, routingStatus and hostingStatus (online or offline), and a summary of its command in flight when there is one. Returns schema Deployment.

tools.name: get_release_diagnostics
tools.description: Read what the stored rows say about a release: its status and failure code, its most recent steps (at most 20) with failure codes and times, the project's most recent commands (at most 10) with failure codes, each failure code with failureRetryable (whether a new deploy or build of the same input may succeed), and the outcome of the source-published event it came from. Bounded and redacted: codes, counts and times only. Returns schema Diagnostics.

tools.name: build_release
tools.description: Prototype tool (decision 0014; decision 0016 section 5 item 2): request the build of an accepted release, or the next build attempt of a building release whose last attempt failed while attempts remain. The build worker starts the pending attempt; this tool writes nothing and never calls the build system. Not a command: it takes no idempotency key. Refused with RELEASE_NOT_BUILDABLE when the release has no pending build attempt, and with BUILD_IN_PROGRESS while an attempt runs. Returns the release as read when the request was accepted (schema Release), so its build step may still be pending.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: List the project's releases, newest first, one page at a time: each with its gitCommitSha, status and failure code (with failureRetryable), without steps (read one with get_release). Returns {items, page}: items are ReleaseSummary objects, page is {limit, nextCursor}. Pass page.nextCursor as cursor for the next page; it is null on the last page.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 50; 20 when absent. Outside 1 to 50 is OUT_OF_RANGE.

cursor.description: The page.nextCursor of the previous result, unchanged. One the service did not make is INVALID_FORMAT.

tools.name: list_commands
tools.description: List the project's commands, newest first, one page at a time, hosting commands created from Payment events included: kind, commandNumber, status and failure code (with failureRetryable). Returns {items, page}: items are Command objects, page is {limit, nextCursor}. Pass page.nextCursor as cursor for the next page; it is null on the last page.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 50; 20 when absent. Outside 1 to 50 is OUT_OF_RANGE.

cursor.description: The page.nextCursor of the previous result, unchanged. One the service did not make is INVALID_FORMAT.

tools.name: suspend_website
tools.description: Admin: accept a suspend of one website, offline reason admin_suspended. It adds only that reason: a site already offline for another reason stays offline, and the other reasons are kept. Refused while another command of the project is in flight or the route is not stable. Only a caller holding the ADMIN role may call it, on any project, without the project access check; anyone else is refused with ACCESS_DENIED before the project is looked at. The production profile refuses it with OPERATION_UNAVAILABLE. Returns the accepted command (schema CommandAccepted): commandId, status and statusUrl.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key scoped to the project: 1 to 249 bytes of UTF-8 (stored as admin:<key>, which keeps 255 bytes), with no control characters and no leading or trailing white space; 250 to 255 bytes is TOO_LONG. It never takes a key of a system event: project-deleted sent here is a separate admin key. The same key with the same request returns the original command; with a different request it is refused with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

tools.name: resume_website
tools.description: Admin: accept a resume of one website. It removes only the offline reason admin_suspended; the site comes back online only when no other reason is left. Refused while another command of the project is in flight or the route is not stable. Only a caller holding the ADMIN role may call it, on any project, without the project access check; anyone else is refused with ACCESS_DENIED before the project is looked at. The production profile refuses it with OPERATION_UNAVAILABLE. Returns the accepted command (schema CommandAccepted): commandId, status and statusUrl.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key scoped to the project: 1 to 249 bytes of UTF-8 (stored as admin:<key>, which keeps 255 bytes), with no control characters and no leading or trailing white space; 250 to 255 bytes is TOO_LONG. It never takes a key of a system event: project-deleted sent here is a separate admin key. The same key with the same request returns the original command; with a different request it is refused with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

tools.name: redeploy_release
tools.description: Admin: accept a redeploy of the project's live release: its pods restart with the same image, and the route does not change. Refused with REDEPLOY_NOT_ALLOWED when the project has no live release or hosting is offline, with ROUTE_NOT_STABLE when the route is not stable, and with COMMAND_IN_PROGRESS while another command is in flight. Only a caller holding the ADMIN role may call it, on any project, without the project access check; anyone else is refused with ACCESS_DENIED before the project is looked at. The production profile refuses it with OPERATION_UNAVAILABLE. Returns the accepted command (schema CommandAccepted): commandId, status and statusUrl.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key scoped to the project: 1 to 255 bytes of UTF-8, with no control characters and no leading or trailing white space, in the same key space as deploy, promote and rollback. The same key with the same request returns the original command; with a different request it is refused with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

tools.name: admin_list_commands
tools.description: Admin: list the project's commands, newest first, one page at a time, as list_commands does, each with requestedBySubject: the subject that asked for it (absent for a command from an event). Only a caller holding the ADMIN role may call it, on any project, without the project access check; anyone else is refused with ACCESS_DENIED before the project is looked at. Returns {items, page}: items are AdminCommand objects, page is {limit, nextCursor}. Pass page.nextCursor as cursor for the next page; it is null on the last page.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 50; 20 when absent. Outside 1 to 50 is OUT_OF_RANGE.

cursor.description: The page.nextCursor of the previous result, unchanged. One the service did not make is INVALID_FORMAT.
